'''Ingan dire Stane''' was a [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]], who operated a [[Aral tukor Viest's clearinghouse|clearinghouse]] in the [[Far Xandil sector/Legends|Far Xandil sector]]. At some point, a [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdian]] named [[Aral tukor Viest]] ended up in his possession. After years of servitude, Viest betrayed her master, [[Death/Legends|killed]] him and took over his operations.<ref name="Razor's Edge">''[[Razor's Edge]]''</ref>
